label: r4c2
name: x roll + more updates, lr 1.5e-3
hypothesis: Same network as r3c1. The recipe uses n_envs 128 (2048 samples per update, so about twice as many updates), 32 minibatches of 64 and lr 1.5e-3. Fresher data, about twice the gradient steps and a higher learning rate should speed learning, since r3c1 was still improving at the end. Refuted if dev success is at or below 0.80, or it collapses to DONE because steps are too large.
